segments.title: Log Observatory
segments.screen: Folie 1 zeigen. Nach dem ersten Satz kurz pausieren.
segments.speech: When a system fails, an engineer needs a diagnostic next step. A team lead needs recurring patterns. A manager needs a reason to act first. Log Observatory answers these questions using nearly five million real log lines and traceable database evidence.

segments.title: SereneDB calculates. The agent explains
segments.screen: Folie 2 zeigen und die Architektur von links nach rechts erklären. Danach zum vorbereiteten Engineer-Clip wechseln.
segments.speech: We parse BGL and OpenStack logs and load our own schema into local SereneDB. We define a fictional ownership map. Fixed tools search and calculate. The agent chooses tools, explains the evidence and recommends a check. Each investigation retains its executed SQL.

segments.title: Engineer: the exception is inside the traceback
segments.screen: 00:50-00:55 Folie 3. Dann echter Engineer-Clip: Rolle Engineer, Datensatz OpenStack, All teams. Frage absenden. Antwort und Belege search_logs/get_context zeigen. SQL und Log 4793594 bzw. 4793598 sichtbar machen. Am Ende kurz auf Folie 3 zurück. Ladezeit darf herausgeschnitten werden.
segments.speech: The engineer asks why the image cache manager keeps failing. The agent searches the message and retrieves context. It finds eight matching failure messages. The traceback identifies InvalidDiskInfo. The qemu-img command cannot open an instance disk: the path does not exist. We can inspect the exact log IDs and SQL. Next, check the disk path and related deletion or storage activity. This explains the inspected failure. The other seven reports still need checking.

segments.title: Team Lead: recurring patterns and their reach
segments.screen: 01:45-01:50 Folie 4. Dann Team-Lead-Clip: BGL, HPC Kernel. Agent-Antwort und top_patterns/pattern_trend-Belege zeigen. Im direkten Bereich Run prepared investigation und Compare leading patterns können die Diagramme erzeugen. Aggregation und Zeitreihe sichtbar halten.
segments.speech: The team lead compares patterns across HPC Kernel. SQL finds around one hundred fifty-three thousand TLB error lines. The trend shows a concentrated burst: more than one hundred fifty-two thousand in one weekly bucket. Storage interrupts occur less often, but reach more nodes. Investigate that wider pattern and check the localized burst. These are log counts and observed nodes, not confirmed incidents or affected customers.

segments.title: Manager: frequency and reach change the priority
segments.screen: 02:35-02:40 Folie 5. Dann Manager-Clip: BGL, All teams. Antwort mit beiden Volltextsuchen und priority_ranking zeigen. In Query evidence die Faktoren bzw. zugehörige Tabelle öffnen. Kurz SQL und Ergebniszeilen im selben Clip zeigen.
segments.speech: The manager compares frequency and reach. TLB errors produce more lines, but appear on five hundred forty-one nodes. Storage interrupts appear on twenty-two thousand five hundred twenty-nine nodes. Our score combines frequency, severity, reach, trend and alerts. Storage interrupts rank first in this BGL comparison. We recommend investigating them first. The score supports prioritization. It does not measure financial damage.

segments.title: The same tools work through MCP
segments.screen: Folie 6 zeigen. Optional 3-5 Sekunden echte Claude-/mcp-Ansicht mit sieben Tools einblenden, falls euer Kollege sie aufgenommen hat. Keine erfolgreiche Claude-Antwort behaupten, solange diese Aufnahme fehlt.
segments.speech: The same functions also work through MCP. Assistants can discover seven read tools and three role prompts. Results have clear limits and SQL evidence. Claude connection instructions are included. The server makes no model calls.

segments.title: A supervised pilot with an operations team
segments.screen: Folie 7 zeigen. Pilot als Vorschlag formulieren. Keine gemessene Zeit- oder Geldersparnis behaupten.
segments.speech: Next, we propose a supervised pilot with an operations team. We want to reduce manual log lookup and improve handovers. We would compare time to a supported next action, answer quality and investigation cost with the current workflow. Customer savings still need validation.

segments.title: Evidence first, human decisions
segments.screen: Folie 8 bis zum Ende zeigen. Spätestens bei 04:40 stoppen. Appendix-Folien 9 und 10 im Video auslassen, aber im einzureichenden PDF behalten.
segments.speech: This prototype uses historical public logs and fictional ownership. Event grouping and scores remain heuristics. People verify recommendations before acting. A customer pilot needs access controls and sensitive-data handling. Each role gets a supported next step, with evidence ready to inspect.

questions.question: What causes the recurring ComputeManager._run_image_cache_manager_pass failure, and how often does it recur? Inspect the traceback and distinguish observations from hypotheses. Give one next check with log IDs.

Which problems recur for HPC Kernel across the recorded BGL period? Compare full aggregate frequency and observed node reach for data TLB error interrupt and data storage interrupt. Inspect the weekly trend of BGL-0019 and recommend a next investigation. Cite evidence and disclose truncation.

Should we investigate data storage interrupt or data TLB error interrupt first? Use exact-phrase search aggregations for both and BGL priority_ranking. Compare full matching-line totals and observed node reach. Explain the score factors and recommend one next check. Do not invent economic impact or a score for a group outside the returned ranking.
